PLAN_TITLE: G2-17475 UAT - Near Real-Time Sync From WCS To Tapir Oblivion
EPIC_SUMMARY: Near real-time sync from WCS to Tapir - Oblivion
EPIC_CREATED_BY: Cobbe, Valentina || YOOX NET A PORTER
COVERAGE_SUMMARY: No child stories are directly linked to this epic. Coverage is enriched via the linked Initiative G2-16119 (Customer Data Synchronization – WCS to Tapir) which provides architectural context, latency SLA (< 5 seconds), data-scope definition, and links to 10+ Done sibling epics. Sibling Done stories G2-17014 (Registered User Deletes an Address, Done) and G2-17021 (Registered User Updates Email, Done, test result Nov-2025) confirm the event-driven WCS-to-Tapir/Gecco sync mechanism is implemented and tested. Coverage spans 6 checks: 4 epic-level AC checks plus 2 new checks derived from Initiative success criteria (latency SLA) and sibling implementation patterns (per-domain PII deletion).
STORIES_IN_SCOPE: No direct child stories. Initiative context: G2-16119 (Customer Data Synchronization – WCS to Tapir). Sibling Done stories used for evidence and pattern derivation: G2-17014 (Registered User Deletes an Address – under G2-17473 Addresses, Done), G2-17021 (Registered User Updates Email – under G2-17476 Email Changes, Done).
STORIES_EXCLUDED: Sibling epics: G2-16317 (Newly created users), G2-16318 (Profile updates), G2-20372 (Wishlist), G2-17473 (Addresses), G2-17476 (Email Changes) – all Done and excluded from scope as they cover distinct event types. Reverse sync from Gecco to WCS (G2-22993).
OUT_OF_SCOPE: Story-level UI flows, technical implementation validation, reverse sync from Gecco to WCS (G2-22993), and non-PII data domains.
DEV_EVIDENCE: Available via Initiative context and sibling Done story evidence. G2-16119 (Initiative) links to 10+ Done sibling epics confirming the event-driven WCS-to-Gecco sync pipeline is implemented. G2-17014 (Registered User Deletes an Address, Done) confirms deletion propagation via the same sync mechanism. G2-17021 test result comment (Nov 2025) confirms sync is functional end-to-end including rejection of conflicting updates. Direct Bitbucket PR access blocked (unauthorized) – sibling story Done status and test results serve as Jira-link fallback evidence.
GAPS_SUMMARY: Oblivion event schema (full-customer deletion) differs from per-entity delete events used in sibling Done epics (G2-17014 deletes a single address). The oblivion trigger, event handler, and PII domain coverage matrix have not been enumerated in the epic ticket. Retry thresholds and SLA measurement points are not defined. Initiative success criteria (< 5s latency, 100% parity) apply but may need oblivion-specific tuning.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Contact: Cobbe, Valentina || YOOX NET A PORTER
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Customer deletion initiated on WCS is reflected on Gecco in near real time
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Delete a test customer in WCS and confirm the customer profile is removed or anonymized in Gecco within expected sync latency. The customer is matched via the parentCustomerUrn identity key established by the sync pipeline (tapir#6382 PorterMigrationMapping; ant#32 forwards ParentCustomerUrn on the message DTOs), so verify the oblivion event resolves to the correct internal customer before erasure.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Deletion/anonymization is reflected on Gecco after WCS deletion event.
No residual active profile remains in Gecco for the deleted customer.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Oblivion event is reflected on Gecco within the near-real-time SLA defined in the initiative (< 5 seconds)
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Trigger a test customer deletion on WCS and measure the elapsed time until the deletion/anonymization is visible in Gecco. Compare against the < 5-second SLA specified in G2-16119 Initiative success criteria.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Deletion is reflected on Gecco within 5 seconds of the WCS oblivion event.
If latency exceeds the SLA, the retry mechanism picks up the event and the final state still converges within a reasonable window.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Contact: Cobbe, Valentina || YOOX NET A PORTER
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Each PII data domain (profile attributes, address entries, consents, credentials/login link) is individually confirmed deleted or anonymized after an oblivion event
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: After a test oblivion event, inspect each domain independently through available business verification paths: (1) profile attributes in Gecco, (2) address book entries, (3) marketing consents, (4) credential/login association. Address-domain removal reuses the delete path proven in tapir#6489 (G2-17014); customer identity resolution uses the parentCustomerUrn mapping (tapir#6382 + ant#32). Confirm the oblivion handler fans out to ALL four domains rather than relying on per-entity delete events.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Profile attributes are removed or anonymized.
Address entries are removed.
Consent records are removed or anonymized.
Credential/login association is severed.
No domain retains identifiable data after completion.
